tooltip.the_long_travail.flavor.kagotsur: A night of drawing water with a bamboo basket; beneath the cold moon at Yatsuhashi, the silhouette of an oiran—autumn dusk, the spring moon deep.
tooltip.the_long_travail.flavor.a_thousa: Fade away with the passage of time…
tooltip.the_long_travail.flavor.book_of_: A long poem, dedicated to the lord of the underworld.
tooltip.the_long_travail.flavor.myriad_s: A madman sharpens his blade by night; the imperial star falters as Mars rises high!
gui.the_long_travail.diary.prose.underwo:
Last night,
someone buried a raven.
The traveler bent low,
and lingered long.

Wind brushed its old name,
bore all softly away.
Never to return, never to return.

The underworld road descends.
White Death smiles at its end.

Below, fell fires burn on;
ash climbs the mortal world.

Who calls? Who answers?
Bloodlight floods charred earth.
Lava flows slow.

The traveler treads a burning pulse,
and storms into the gateless realm.
